description: A chunky low-poly six-wheeled military rocket launcher truck parked on the ground, seen from the front-left. A boxy flat-fronted cab at the front with a flat slatted grille, two square flat headlights and a flat two-pane windscreen; behind the cab a flat chassis bed carrying a big rectangular rocket launcher box on a turntable, the box raised at the front end to about 20 degrees and pointing forward over the cab roof; the front face of the launcher box shows a grid of round tube openings, three rows of six. Six large chunky wheels of the same size: one axle under the cab and two close-set axles under the rear bed. Cab, launcher box and chassis bed sides painted one olive drab green; tube openings, turntable, bumper and grille slats dark gunmetal grey; windscreen and cab side windows a single flat dark blue-grey; tyres dark charcoal, hubs dark olive; headlights pale grey. The rear face of the launcher box and the stabiliser jacks on the rear face face away and are hidden; the right-hand wheels are hidden behind the truck.
proportions: About 9.0 m long, 2.5 m wide and 3.4 m tall with the launcher raised; the six wheels clearly visible. (length : width : height = 3.60 : 1 : 1.36)
sides: the rocket truck is symmetric left to right: the launcher box and its turntable sit on the centre line of the bed, a mirror on each cab corner.
